The HWPX document update failed because required data fields were missing from the XML and modified paragraphs incorrectly retained layout cache elements.
The test 'test_required_values_present_and_repeated_value_updated' failed because '1990-11-02 (35세)' was not found in section0.xml. Additionally, 'test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache' failed with an AssertionError because modified paragraphs still contained 'hp:linesegarray' elements. Ensure that when text is injected into the HWPML, the corresponding paragraph's layout cache is explicitly removed to allow the viewer to re-render the content.
